title: BlockHeterogeneousNonconvex.lean

problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: The setup permits differentiable, nonconvex objectives on ℝᵈ. There is a global lower bound ℓ with f(x₀) − ℓ ≤ Δ. Attainment of the infimum is optional.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: One call at x returns the full vector g(x,ξ) using a fresh IID seed. The map g is jointly measurable, and its reply is integrable with mean ∇f(x). The public input gives d, B, the block assignment, the measurable seed space Ω, x₀, L, σ, Δ, and ε. The objective, oracle map, and seed law are hidden.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/BlockHeterogeneousNonconvex.lean, Params, spec.publicInput, spec.Reply, and spec.admissible. LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean, IID

distinctive_assumptions.label: bounded_variance
distinctive_assumptions.details: At every x, each projected oracle error has second moment E‖Pⱼ(g(x,ξ) − ∇f(x))‖₂² ≤ σⱼ². The public bounds σⱼ ≥ 0 may differ or vanish. Errors in different blocks of the same reply may be correlated.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: The domain is Euclidean ℝᵈ. A public assignment partitions the coordinates into B labeled blocks. Pⱼ is the orthogonal projection onto block j, which may be empty.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Each block has a public Lⱼ > 0. For every x and displacement h, the simultaneous Taylor remainder satisfies |f(x+h) − f(x) − ⟨∇f(x),h⟩| ≤ ½ Σⱼ Lⱼ‖Pⱼh‖₂².

accuracy.label: gradient_norm
accuracy.details: For the returned point X, stationarity is measured by the unsquared mixed norm Σⱼ ‖Pⱼ∇f(X)‖₂. The output may be any measurable point in ℝᵈ.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: The mixed norm must be integrable and satisfy E[Σⱼ ‖Pⱼ∇f(X)‖₂] ≤ ε for public ε > 0. The expectation covers the algorithm seed and the IID oracle stream under their product law. The oracle-call budget is fixed.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/BlockHeterogeneousNonconvex.lean, spec.valid and spec.successful. LongTails/Template.lean, executeWithTrace and Convergence

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: The same coordinate partition governs the smoothness bound, the noise bounds, and the stationarity criterion. A single oracle call observes all blocks, while accuracy sums their individual Euclidean gradient norms.

descriptionHtml:
Nonconvex Optimization with Heterogeneous Blocks

We consider minimizing a differentiable, possibly nonconvex function f:Rd→R in Euclidean dimension d. Its linearization error admits a quadratic bound with a separate coefficient for each coordinate block, and its value at a given starting point lies within a prescribed gap of a global lower bound. At each query, the oracle uses a fresh independent sample to return an unbiased gradient estimate with blockwise variance bounds. For a tolerance ε>0, the goal is a point x¯∈Rd at which the expected sum of the Euclidean norms of the gradient blocks is at most ε.

The optimization problem is infx∈Rdf(x). For nonnegative integers d and B, write [n]={1,…,n} with [0]=∅. A map b:[d]→[B] assigns each coordinate to a block. For j∈[B], let Πj be the orthogonal projection onto the coordinates in b−1(j), which may be empty. The algorithm receives d, B, b, the measurable sample space Ω, the block parameters (Lj,σj)j∈[B] with Lj>0 and σj≥0, the gap bound Δ≥0, the tolerance ε, and the starting point x0∈Rd.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Block smoothness). The function f is differentiable everywhere, and for every x,y∈Rd, |f(y)−f(x)−⟨∇f(x),y−x⟩|≤12∑j∈[B]Lj∥Πj(y−x)∥2.

Assumption 2 (Initial objective gap). There exists ℓ∈R such that f(x)≥ℓ for every x∈Rd and f(x0)−ℓ≤Δ.

Assumption 3 (Stochastic gradients with blockwise variance bounds). On call k at any x∈Rd, the oracle returns g(x,ξk), where g:Rd×Ω→Rd is jointly measurable. The samples (ξk)k≥0 are independent measurable random variables with common law ν on Ω, and the sequence is independent of the algorithm’s randomness. For ξ∼ν, every x∈Rd, and every j∈[B], the vector g(x,ξ) is Bochner integrable, the squared norm ∥Πj(g(x,ξ)−∇f(x))∥2 is integrable, and Eξ∼ν[g(x,ξ)]=∇f(x),Eξ∼ν[∥Πj(g(x,ξ)−∇f(x))∥2]≤σj2.

After the allotted oracle calls, the output x¯ must be measurable and ∑j∈[B]∥Πj∇f(x¯)∥ must be integrable under the joint law of the samples and the algorithm’s randomness. Under this law, the required accuracy is E[∑j∈[B]∥Πj∇f(x¯)∥]≤ε.

Let Pj project onto coordinate block j of Rd. The differentiable objective satisfies f(x0)−inff≤Δ and, for all x,h, |f(x+h)−f(x)−⟨∇f(x),h⟩|≤12∑j=1BLj∥Pjh∥22, with Lj>0. Each call returns a jointly measurable, integrable full gradient estimate g(x,ξ) from a fresh IID sample, with Eg(x,ξ)=∇f(x) and E∥Pj(g(x,ξ)−∇f(x))∥22≤σj2, σj≥0. The target is E∑j∥Pj∇f(x^)∥2≤ε, ε>0.

(5) requires block-separable gradients and almost-sure noise bounds above and away from zero in noisy layers. (1) gives expected accuracy for Euclidean blocks. import LongTails.Template
import LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.PiL2
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Lp.MeasurableSpace
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Gradient.Basic

open MeasureTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace

namespace LongTails.Setups.BlockHeterogeneousNonconvex

open OracleTemplate

noncomputable def blockProj {d B : ℕ} (blk : Fin d → Fin B) (j : Fin B) :
    EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
  LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap
    { toFun := fun x => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => if blk i = j then x i else 0)
      map_add' := by
        intro x y
        ext i
        by_cases h : blk i = j <;> simp [h]
      map_smul' := by
        intro a x
        ext i
        by_cases h : blk i = j <;> simp [h] }

structure Params where
  d : ℕ
  B : ℕ
  blk : Fin d → Fin B
  Ω : Type
  [measurableΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
  L : Fin B → ℝ
  σ : Fin B → ℝ
  Δ : ℝ
  ε : ℝ
  x0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)

attribute [instance] Params.measurableΩ

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  Instance q := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin q.d) → ℝ
  Query q := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin q.d)
  Reply q := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin q.d)
  Output q := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin q.d)
  publicInput q := q
  valid q := (∀ j, 0 < q.L j) ∧ (∀ j, 0 ≤ q.σ j) ∧ 0 ≤ q.Δ ∧ 0 < q.ε
  admissible q f O :=
    ∃ (g : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin q.d) → q.Ω → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin q.d))
      (p : ProbabilityMeasure q.Ω) (P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → q.Ω)),
      LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID
        (fun k (ξ : ℕ → q.Ω) => ξ k) (p : Measure _) (P : Measure _) ∧
      O = { Seed := fun _ => q.Ω
            law := P
            answer := fun _ (_, x) ω => g x ω } ∧
      (∀ x, HasGradientAt f (gradient f x) x) ∧
      (∀ x y, |f y - f x - ⟪gradient f x, y - x⟫| ≤
        (1 / 2) * ∑ j, q.L j * ‖blockProj q.blk j (y - x)‖ ^ 2) ∧
      Measurable (Function.uncurry g) ∧
      (∀ x, Integrable (g x) p) ∧
      (∀ x, ∫ ω, g x ω ∂p = gradient f x) ∧
      (∀ x j, Integrable (fun ω => ‖blockProj q.blk j (g x ω - gradient f x)‖ ^ 2) p) ∧
      (∀ x j, ∫ ω, ‖blockProj q.blk j (g x ω - gradient f x)‖ ^ 2 ∂p ≤ q.σ j ^ 2) ∧
      ∃ lower : ℝ, (∀ x, lower ≤ f x) ∧ f q.x0 - lower ≤ q.Δ
  successful q f output P :=
    Measurable output ∧
      Integrable (fun ω => ∑ j, ‖blockProj q.blk j (gradient f (output ω))‖) (P : Measure _) ∧
      ∫ ω, ∑ j, ‖blockProj q.blk j (gradient f (output ω))‖ ∂(P : Measure _) ≤ q.ε

end LongTails.Setups.BlockHeterogeneousNonconvex
